findings.text: no SVG companion exists for any of the plan's three figures, so the recorded panels cannot be checked as text for line contours, wall and null markers: the vector emitter landed at benchmarks/centroid_constrained_fixture_receipt.py:900 after the banked receipt, CPU re-render job 1273797 refused with "the scientific receipt requires betelgeuse" and job 1273800 was CANCELLED on the 00:59:00 time limit, so nothing produced a vector and the plotting-rule compliance of the published panel is unverified by this review.

the terminal-state save landed after the measurement it would have described, so the banked receipt carries no terminal_state_path and no state file exists under the report directory; the panel's state is recoverable only by re-solving, which is why the published figure came back raster-only and why the record's own lane script has to say the solve is the only route back.

level_error_wb emits -48.70235527547112 on the positive arm, a mixed-gauge subtraction of the level column's own axis-anchored offset from an absolute authored level, while the row's physical error is level_row_scaled_residual 2.3214644865632295e-03; a machine reader of the receipt sees an error figure four decades larger than the error, and the record has to caption the key as not-an-error rather than the receipt declining to emit it.

the guard added with the reader fix compares lattice.node_count with operator.grid.node_number, counts the pre-fix call site never touched, so it passes under both indexings (probe: committed carrier test PASS, pre-fix indexing FAIL with AssertionError, alignment guard silent in both); the one-block shift is covered only by the updated stub test, so loosening that stub silently restores the defect that cost 10.4575 Wb on the analytic state.

justifications.durability: sixteen commits each carry a body, the receipt and diagnostics are banked under the report directory, and the work survived ten process lifetimes (resume-1 through resume-10) with manifest and commits intact; the deduction is that the banked control-positive.json is source_revision 826a7434, which predates the terminal-state save at benchmarks/centroid_constrained_fixture_receipt.py:1006, so the state behind the published panel is on no disk and the panel cannot be re-rendered without re-solving.
justifications.evidence: the two-module gate reproduces first-hand in one all_debug job through the shared interpreter (fixture 8 passed in 8.72 s; protocol 14 passed, 2 failed in 83.92 s with the two eliminated-constraint ids that exist at base 1aa2597d, so zero added failures), the H200 receipt (h200-summary.txt, job 1273572, head 826a7434) carries both exits 0 and its numbers match the plan text digit for digit (centroid error 7.940222055e-04 pitches, row residual 2.321464487e-03, terminal 1.110210658e-03, amplitudes 2.388599065e-03 T and 1.2383665193033397 Wb, bound_refusal [false, false, false]), and the reader defect is legible before and after in the banked diagnostics (diag-reader-vs-oracle-fixed.log +7.597699146e-04 Wb; seed row 1.132393589e+02 against oracle 1.132745853e+02); the deduction is that the figure evidence is raster-only and no text lane can check it.
justifications.fit: the level column enters through the existing protocol (ConstraintPair, ConstraintBinding, BoundedExteriorFieldUnknown with a per-component bound and a per-component refusal exercised by a test I ran first-hand) and the reader dispatches on the carrier rather than a fixture flag, matching the pool convention verified at nova/equilibrium/stencil_mesh.py:245-252 against nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:2747-2753; the deduction is field_bound_applies at nova/equilibrium/constraint.py:549, which no production or receipt path consumes.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the three-column family is delivered as specified — FluxLevelConstraint and the level column at nova/equilibrium/constraint.py:994-1060 with the fixture's level_constraint_pair at scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/centroid_row.py:116-150 (field_bound jnp.inf, tolerance scale*1e-12, level_scale_wb 1.0), the positive control re-posed and the verdict stated clause by clause with the fixed-point clause reported as failing rather than massaged.
justifications.scope_discipline: the eight declared paths match the range's diff and every commit is conventional with a body and zero attribution trailers; the shared-environment incident (a bare uv run from the worktree repointing the editable install) was self-inflicted but detected, repaired from the main checkout with uv sync --inexact --all-extras and reported, and the pointer now reads /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/nova with the extras present; the deduction is that the manifest's changed_paths does not list the figure commit 99f1345e force-added.
